_note: HAIL PROBE HL1 (plan OT-9G, spike office/spikes/2026-11-03-hailing-a-ship.md): one friendly UC citizen cargo ship, vanilla's own hail ship, and a menu cast on it. SILENT (subtitles only) and placeholder words. Not a mission.

Reading it: take it from the board, go to the system. The ship should NOT be there before the accept, and should be after. Hail it. The question the probe answers: does its greeting and the two options below show up in the hail?
Picking the first option should complete the mission and pay easy; the second should loop back to the menu. Shooting it should complete NOTHING (its death hook is removed).
